most_similar_reason: Candidate 3 matches the target almost episode for episode: a god secretly warns a chosen man of a divinely decreed flood, he builds a great boat and loads it with kin and animals, the storm destroys all humanity, the boat grounds on a mountain, birds (including a raven and a dove) are released to test the waters, and he offers a sacrifice after which the gods relent and bless him.
least_similar_reason: Candidate 2 shares no flood, no divine destruction of humanity, no rescued righteous survivor and no covenant, instead telling of a musician's failed underworld rescue of his wife and his dismemberment.
